2034-7084-8293.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Ashnod's Altar ability.
Repeat.

2023-4289-4770-6633.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-1833-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Stormbound Geist
When Stormbound Geist dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
728-1833-6972.notes: If Stormbound Geist starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

222-527-3899-6965.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-3899-6965.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

1981-2292-2415-6578.easyPrerequisites: You either have Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER on the battlefield or have the emblem granted by Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel.
1981-2292-2415-6578.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sephiroth and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sephiroth trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2921-5233-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Boros Garrison.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Boros Garrison from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boros Garrison enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

1987-4823-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-4823-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
1987-4823-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4823-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2204-5686-6972.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1133-1669-1825.easyPrerequisites:
You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
It is your upkeep step.
1133-1669-1825.description:
During your upkeep, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Hakim's first ability by paying {U}{U}, returning Treachery from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Hakim.
When Treachery enters, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Treachery.
Repeat.

3941-4067-6281-7252.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Grave Sifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Grave Sifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Grave Sifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to an artifact creature that doesn't have summoning sickness

1978-2113-3430.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact creature that does not have summoning sickness.
1978-2113-3430.description:
Activate an artifact creature by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the artifact creature.
Repeat.

1029-2466-7010.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Gran-Gran, adding {C}
Gran-Gran triggers, causing you to loot.
Tolarian Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to untap Gran-Gran.
Repeat.

967-2438-3809-4365-7087.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1597-1978-5517.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat

1778-2173-5220-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2034-3490-6829.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Venom triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1796-2866-3689-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3705-4050-5997-6441.description:
Cast Squee from your graveyard or from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating two 2/2 Alien Warrior creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing Squee and the Alien Warriors, adding {1}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

851-1409-6348.notablePrerequisites: You control a Dragon and/or have a Dragon card in hand.
851-1409-6348.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, either choosing a Dragon you control or revealing a Dragon card from your hand and creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2043-5921-6252.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Boommobile that is a 1/1 Soldier artifact creature.
When the Boommobile token enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {8} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2043-5921-6252.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate a Boommobile to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

719-1789-5147-5649.notablePrerequisites: Xenograft on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
719-1789-5147-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2897-5329-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Gigantoplasm on the battlefield as a copy of Forensic Researcher.
Forensic Researcher and Gigantoplasm do not have summoning sickness.
2897-5329-5475.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Gigantoplasm.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Gigantoplasm.
Activate Gigantoplasm by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Gigantoplasm ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

141-5900-6001--69.description:
Cast Megaton's Fate by paying {5}{R}, targeting the indestructible artifact.
Holding priority, activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Megaton's Fate, with the copy targeting the indestructible artifact.
Resolve the copy of Megaton's Fate, failing to destroy the artifact due to it being indestructible, and creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-2232-2837-5270.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, Samwise Gamgee's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
When the Cat enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Memnite from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

823-2232-4740.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 5.
You have a black nonartifact permanent card in hand with mana cost {B}.
You control a nontoken nonartifact black permanent with mana cost {B} that shares a card type with the card in hand.
823-2232-4740.description:
Cast the black permanent card in your hand by paying 2 life.
Defiler of Flesh and Aetherflux Reservoir triggers.
Resolve the Defiler of Flesh trigger, giving target creature +1/+1 and menace until end of turn.
Resolve the Aetherflux Reservoir trigger, causing you to gain 1 life for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
The black permanent enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning another nontoken nonartifact black permanent with mana cost {B} from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite life, you may activate Aetherflux Reservoir infinite times to deal infinite damage to any target(s).

1722-1926-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Tentacle.
"Tentacle" chosen with Species Specialist.
1722-1926-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
The Tentacle dies, triggering Species Specialist, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Repeat.

2034-2323-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-2323-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Body Dropper, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3818-4050-5189.notablePrerequisites: Sengir has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
3818-4050-5189.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {1}.
The Saproling dies, triggering Sengir's first ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Repeat.

328-2173-4050-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2173-4050-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Rite of Passage

292-1495-4753.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage and Clever Impersonator trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
